subject: Mobile Development
title: Eight Billion Mobile Subscriptions
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Eight Billion Mobile Subscriptions.

hook.text: There are now more active mobile subscriptions than people on Earth.

buildup.text: Over 8 billion mobile connections exist, covering even the most remote regions.

discovery.text: In developing nations, many people skipped landlines entirely and went straight to mobile.

twist.text: Some people have two or three SIM cards — one for each carrier to get the best rates.

climax.text: Mobile connectivity is the most widely adopted technology in human history.

punchline.text: More SIM cards exist than human beings.

quiz.question: How many mobile subscriptions exist worldwide?
